verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers developer-oriented bots, webhooks, connectors, and Graph API automation, but contains no mention of a no-code workflow builder (e.g., Power Automate/Workflows app) that a team-admin could use to trigger flows from events, schedules, or form submissions directly inside Teams chat. Webhooks/connectors require external services and JSON formatting, not a no-code admin experience, so the story's core requirement is unevidenced.
